uncertainty_notes: Tiny single-function module — isDate() with strict regex + UTC round-trip + year>=1 guard. HIGH-14/O4-HI-03/Codex-NEW-5 fix correctly closes the 5 known impossible-date bypasses (99/99, 13-01, Feb 30, year 0, Apr 31). Tests cover all 5 reject cases + 3 accept cases (today, leap-year Feb 29, Dec 31) + non-string inputs + non-leap Feb 29 + century non-leap-year rule. Both /api/operator/backfill and /api/operator/manual-overrides import the same validator, with a dedicated parity test block confirming they agree.

test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Regex /\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/ would not match '10000-01-01' so it's rejected by shape. But '0001-01-01' (smallest valid year) is not explicitly tested.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: isDate('0001-01-01') → true (smallest valid year); isDate('10000-01-01') → false (out of regex).

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test for negative year (impossible in regex but worth pinning).
